verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe two prompt-driven AI agents. In the 3D editor, the agent builds and edits scenes, handling objects, materials, lighting, animation and interactivity. In Hana, you describe a screen and the agent builds it on the canvas with layout, type, colour, effects, states and interactions, which you can then edit by hand. Text-to-3D model generation and text-to-texture generation add to this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality, since all evidence is vendor documentation and the community items predate these AI features.
